key_insight: OVQRTE updates a parameterized quantum circuit by enforcing Ehrenfest equations for selected observables, trading a controllable measurement burden for improved real-time simulation of correlated quantum dynamics.
engineering_relevance: The method targets near-term quantum hardware by using only expectation-value measurements and was demonstrated on simulator and up to 24-qubit superconducting hardware, making it relevant for scalable quantum simulation workflows.
method: Choose a reduced set of observables to define the operator manifold.
Evolve circuit parameters so measured observables satisfy the Ehrenfest equations in real time.
Use the resulting samples for tasks such as QSCI and gGut embedding calculations.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports simulator benchmarks on the Heisenberg model and hardware runs on the IQM Emerald processor for Anderson impurity models, showing a practical evaluation across up to 24 qubits.
watch_item: Accuracy depends on the selected operator set, so the measurement-cost reduction may come with a tunable but nontrivial risk of missing relevant dynamics if the observable basis is too small.
paper_title: Variational Real-Time Dynamics on Reduced Operator Manifolds
